intro-section.title: Witamy!
intro-section.intro:
We’re getting married in Poland to celebrate our shared heritage and our future together.

We hope you can join us!

transportation.title: Transportation
transportation.additional-info: Shuttles between Zywiec and Beskidian provided

getting-there.info: Free shuttles will be available between Żywiec Stary Zamek and Beskidian, the hotel and reception venue. Limitted on-site parking is available at a cost of 8 pln per hour.

notes.info: We will be having a symbolic wedding ceremony in the castle courtyard. Please dress to be outdoors.

getting-there.info: Free parking is available on-site at Beskidian. Beskidian is also a ten minute walk from the Węgierska Górka train station with service to cities such as Kraków or Katowice. The quickest train routes from Kraków are under three hours and transfer through Czechowice-Dziedzice.

accommodations.info: Accommodations will be provided on-site at Beskidian Hotel for the night of the wedding (Saturday 12th). Hotel check-out for Sunday morning has been extended to 13:00 to align with the start of the after party. Please see FAQ for more information about accommodations.

after-party.info: In Poland, it is traditional to hold a second less formal event the day after the wedding known as “Poprawiny”, roughly translating to “the do-over”. This event is typically held in the evening, but we will be holding it earlier to give guests more time for travel afterwards. This event is optional.

notes.info: Cocktail hour and the after party will take place in the outdoor gazebo. Please dress accordingly.

car.details: Węgierska Górka is about a two hour drive from Kraków. Free parking is available at Beskidian, the hotel and reception venue, but parking at the ceremony venue is paid (8 pln/hr).

transit.details: Węgierska Górka is a less than 3 hour train ride from Kraków, transferring through Czechowice-Dziedzice. Beskidian, the hotel and reception venue, is a 10 minute walk from the train station.

to-ceremony.details: Free shuttles between the ceremony and reception venues will be provided.

accommodations.details1:
Accommodations will be provided gratis at Beskidian Hotel for the night of the wedding (Saturday 12th). Details and room assignments will be distributed after RSVP and may include some shared rooms depending on the final guest count.

If you plan to arrive before Saturday or to extend your stay more than one night at Beskidian, please reach out directly to the hotel after RSVPing and receiving confirmation of your accomodations:
accommodations.details2: If you are attending the Bachelor/ette, the option to extend your stay at Beskidian will be included in the RSVP and estimated cost for that event and no direct outreach to Beskidian is required. Please see the Bachelor/ette page for more information.

plus-ones.details: All guests who do not already have a partner listed on their invitation are welcome to bring a plus one. If you are planning to bring a plus one, please include them on your RSVP.

children.details: While the wedding is catered towards adults, your children are welcome to join you if you would like. If your children will be attending the wedding, please indicate this on your RSVP.

dress-code.details1:
The dress code is romantic cocktail attire. Please be prepared for dancing and for outdoor weather. The ceremony will be held in a castle courtyard with uneven cobblestone and cocktail hour will be held on a lawn. Weather in Poland in September is typically pleasant but can vary between hot, cold and rainy.

General guidance:

bullets.bullet2: Suit pants and button down shirt. Suit jackets, vests, ties or bow-ties optional.
bullets.bullet3: Classy but comfortable shoes for dancing and outdoor celebrations.
bullets.bullet4: Shawl, additional layer and/or umbrella recommended in case of rain or cool weather.

dress-code.details2: Please avoid wearing white, cream or overly bright colors due to the historical setting of the ceremony.

registry.details:
Your presence is more than enough, we are honored that you will be joining us in Poland!
If you would like to provide a gift, we kindly ask that you refrain from physical objects as we will be traveling from abroad and our ability to bring gifts back with us is limited. If you would like to provide a cash donation, a card box will be available at the wedding or you can directly transfer paula.and.terrance@gmail.com including your name so that we can thank you for your gift. We appreciate your understanding!

more-questions.details: Please see our International FAQ section for questions related to international travel or reach out to paula.and.terrance@gmail.com if you have additional questions.

welcome-drinks.title: Welcome Drinks
welcome-drinks.details:
We will be having an informal gathering for family and bridal party members the evening before the wedding at Krajcar Brewery in Żywiec. We’d like to give the families a chance to get to meet each other and the bride and groom before the official ceremony.

If you are included in this event it will be listed in your invitation and RSVP. Transportation will be available from Beskidian with exact timing provided closer to the date. Food and drinks can be purchased individually.
